Search the text of the speeches

Source: R/text.R
parl_search.Rd

Returns the speeches whose text contains pattern.

Usage

parl_search(
  pattern,
  ...,
  regex = FALSE,
  ignore_case = TRUE,
  ignore_accents = TRUE
)

Arguments

pattern

Character. A word or phrase, or a regular expression when regex = TRUE.

...

Filters passed to parl_speeches() (year, party, person...).

regex

Logical. Treat pattern as a regular expression (ICU syntax).

ignore_case

Logical. Case-insensitive search (default TRUE).

ignore_accents

Logical. Accent-insensitive search (default TRUE), useful with OCR and period spellings.

Value

A tibble as in parl_speeches(), with an extra column n_matches.

Examples

old <- parl_use_sample()
parl_search("Seu d'Urgell")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 27
#>     any sessio data       ordre pagina orador orador_cru carrec nom_sencer party
#>   <int> <chr>  <date>     <int>  <int> <chr>  <chr>      <chr>  <chr>      <chr>
#> 1  1933 DSPC_… 1933-03-07   147     19 COMPA… COMPANYS   NA     Josep Com… ERC  
#> 2  1933 DSPC_… 1933-03-07   153     19 VENTO… VENTOSA I… NA     Joan Vent… LR   
#> # ℹ 17 more variables: party_data <chr>, id_persona <chr>, es_diputat <lgl>,
#> #   resolucio <chr>, assignacio_dubtosa <lgl>, es_carrec <lgl>,
#> #   es_anonim <lgl>, acotacio <chr>, n_car <int>, te_taula <lgl>,
#> #   paraules <int>, mes <chr>, govern <chr>, es_govern <lgl>,
#> #   circumscripcio <chr>, text <chr>, n_matches <int>
parl_use_sample(old)
